duplicates.proposed_title: Align every vendored settings resolver to one precedence contract with [env]-only reads
duplicates.existing_title: second-opinion: drop the legacy .env layer — kendex.settings.toml + .env.local only
duplicates.reason: OWNER DECISION CONFLICT — do not cancel without explicit confirmation. KEN-560 records an owner decision (2026-08-24): second-opinion reads exactly two homes and a stale .env fails loud with a migration error. The spec's decision 3 (2026-08-27, post-challenge) instead keeps .env as the lowest layer of the canonical default precedence for every resolver. The proposal fully covers KEN-560's file scope (skills/second-opinion/scripts/lib/kendex-env.sh) but with contradictory .env semantics. Either KEN-560 stands and the spec's default order must drop .env (spec amendment), or the spec's newer order stands and KEN-560 is cancelled as superseded. RESOLVED at approval 2026-08-27: owner chose to drop .env everywhere; KEN-560 cancels as absorbed into issue 1.
